Definition: Each setup is simulated independently in a single iteration: position opens, immediately closes via forward return shortcut, cash is recycled to balance, active positions count is reset to 0.
COBA_014_Evidence: Active_Positions_Count == 0 for all 150 rows in PORTFOLIO_EQUITY; Invested_Capital == 0 for all rows; Exit_Date is synthetic string tag {date}+H5.
Scientific_Validity: Valid for testing discrete single-trade accounting formulas; INVALID for true multi-asset portfolio drawdown, capital contention, or concurrency.

Definition: Positions execute in chronological order with cash balance carried over, but only 1 position held at any time.
COBA_014_Evidence: Cash balance was carried over across setups, but same-day setups were processed sequentially rather than concurrently.
Scientific_Validity: Does not reflect realistic portfolio dynamics where multi-day positions overlap across time.

Definition: Calendar-stepped simulation where positions are held for actual N trading sessions, concurrently competing for cash and portfolio slots up to max concurrency.
COBA_014_Evidence: NOT implemented in COBA_014; active_positions was never held across dates.
Scientific_Validity: Mandatory before any portfolio-level performance or utility claims can be made.
